info.title: Poll Results API
info.description: Political poll results (approval, president, senate, house, governor, other), synced from the New York Times.

200.description: Poll types currently available in the store

types.description: e.g. approval, president, senate, house, governor, other

get.summary: Get paginated poll results for a type (or `all` to merge every type), optionally filtered by state/district

schema.description: Poll category, or `all` to merge every category

parameters.description: Poll category, or `all` to merge every category
parameters.name: type

schema.description: Two-letter state code filter, e.g. NC

parameters.description: Two-letter state code filter, e.g. NC
parameters.name: state

schema.description: Congressional district / seat number filter (house only)

parameters.description: Congressional district / seat number filter (house only)
parameters.name: district

schema.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `cursor` field (anchored to the poll's posted-at timestamp + ID, stable and sorted newest-posted-first even as new polls come in)

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `cursor` field (anchored to the poll's posted-at timestamp + ID, stable and sorted newest-posted-first even as new polls come in)
parameters.name: cursor

items.description: A single poll, grouped into questions -> answers

cursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page, or null if there are no more results
